utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — could you please repeat the timing and transport plan? I’m trying to make sure nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — we’ll go over the timing first, then I’ll make sure the transport plan is clear so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — could you also tell me who’s handling the transport, so I can plan around it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m on it, Rosa — I’ll check in with the neighbors and bring my notes back for you to compare.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate it. Bring your notes back when you’re done, and we’ll compare them so we can prioritize the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do, Rosa — I’ll check in with the neighbors and bring my notes back so we can compare them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Sam — could you help sort what still works and what needs fixing? I’m trying to keep the repair drive moving along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, I can help sort through it. Just point me to what still works and what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Uli — I really appreciate it. I’ll point you to the pile and we can get this repair drive moving along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll add you in — really appreciate it, Rey!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure thing — I’ll meet you at the community center parking lot on Maple after 3.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ve got you down for the community center parking lot on Maple after 3 — see you then!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like it’s really coming together already—thanks, Bo. If you hear anything new, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. I’ll keep an ear out too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check with the other groups and confirm what’s coming today, then I’ll let you know so we can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good — so we’re still definitely on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — as far as I know, we’re still on for today, and I’m checking the other groups now to confirm what’s coming.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure everyone knows the time for the repair drive. I’ll also help keep transport straight so folks are on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good—I’m glad it’s staying organized. I’m mostly hearing updates secondhand, so let me know if there’s anything else I should pass along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep spreading the word, and I’ll pass along anything new about the time or transport so everyone stays on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, thanks — I’ll meet you by the garage in ten minutes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, I’ll be there by the garage in ten minutes too. Then we can sort the donations table first and decide the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’m on my way now and will help sort the donations table first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — what time and place should I check first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Start with the community center at 10 a.m.; that’s where the sign-up sheet and supplies table will be. If anything’s missing, just note it and I’ll help fill the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll check the community center at 10 a.m. and note anything missing on the sign-up sheet or supplies table.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can grab tape, zip ties, and check for a hammer and screwdriver set. I’ll keep it quick and let you know if I find anything else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep sorting what we’ve got and update the list with anything still missing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m on it — I’ll grab those and report back if I spot anything else missing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, so I’m lining up the list and volunteers for that day.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. Just let me know what task or time slot you want me to take.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Sam — I’ll put you down and send the task list once I finish matching everyone to Sunday’s slots.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure it’s still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still on for today. See you at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just wanted to make sure. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Faye—let’s sort the donations first, then make the parts list and assign the pickup and repair jobs.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—that order works. Let’s meet tomorrow at 3:30 and tackle the donations first, then the parts list and job assignments.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I’ll be there tomorrow at 3:30, and we’ll start with the donations and then the parts list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll keep an eye out and be ready to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s looking great so far — I’ll swing by later with the updated list of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Tess — I’m ready to help once you send the list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll come by after drop-off at 3:30. Thanks for getting the tools and bins ready, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Faye — I’ll have the tools and bins ready by 3:30. See you after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll head over right after drop-off and see you at 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks—can you make sure the bikes and small appliances are in the right pile before Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’ll do my best to sort the bikes and small appliances into the right piles before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. If you can, please double-check the right pile by Friday so we’re not scrambling on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I can check the supply box and the sign-up sheet today. I’ll do my best to keep the timing and transport sorted too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — that would really help. If you can keep an eye on the timing and transport, I’ll feel much better about the drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’ll keep an eye on both and check the box and sheet today. I might need a nudge, but I’m on it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks—so it’s the community center parking lot on Maple after 3, right? If you want, I can still check the notice for the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes — that’s right, and if you spot the exact spot on the notice, please send it along. I’ll keep your name down too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check the notice and send the exact spot if I find it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing—send me the missing items and I’ll grab them on my errands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check the tools, supplies, and volunteer list, then send you a quick note with anything still missing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I’ll keep an eye out once you send the list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’d appreciate that. I probably glanced right past it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — I’m checking the exact location now so I can point you right there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I’m easy to miss the fine print, so that helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — I’ll keep sorting supplies and have the needs list ready when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll be there a bit late, but I can jump in as soon as I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, Dane — I’ll keep everything organized and have the list ready for you when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll sort the donations table and keep an eye on the tool sign-out sheet. Just point me to where you want me set up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — I’ll point you to the donations table when you get there. If you don’t spot me right away, just ask at the community center desk.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll head to the community center desk and then get set up at the donations table.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, Hana — I’ll bring the screwdriver set, flashlight, and a small wrench if I can find one. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — that sounds perfect. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: See you there, Hana — I’ve got the tools covered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s start with the hall faucet. It’s quick, and I can handle it first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect—thanks, Leo. I’ll be right there to help with the hall faucet and keep an eye on the washer.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll grab the wrench and get started on the hall faucet now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good—I can take a look at whatever still works and see what can be mended.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good. Can you check the broken hinge on the back gate first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can do that. I’ll check the hinge first and see what’s salvageable.
